settings.heading: You post it. We put ad money behind it.
settings.lede: No follower minimum, no scripts, and nobody gets paid to say a club is good. You post the videos, and we put ad money behind the best ones.

settings.heading: Three things, and none of them are a discount code

settings.title: A free wedge, then the bag
settings.text: Your first wedge is free when you ask. Post every month and a new club opens up each month.

settings.title: Your videos, run as ads
settings.text: We put real ad money behind the best ones, from your handle, and you get a share of what they sell. Your link pays 10% on top.

settings.title: The Clubhouse
settings.text: A leaderboard, weekly races anyone can win, and Charms for posting that turn into hats and polos.

settings.heading: Tell us the truth, including when it's not flattering
settings.body: We pay for sales, never for reviews. Nobody gets paid to say a club is good.
settings.after: We read every application and answer either way.
settings.p_text: Linking your best posts gets you a faster yes. Ads can only run from Instagram, so that's the handle worth giving us.

settings.text: Film with your Lucky clubs: range sessions, real rounds, honest reactions.
Post it as an Instagram Reel and tag @luckygolfofficial. Post it everywhere else too, but the Reel is the one we can run as an ad.
Say it's a partnership. Every post with our gear gets a clear disclosure, paid or not.

settings.question: How many followers do I need?
Do I get paid?
settings.answer: Yes, for sales. When an ad we run from your video sells, you earn a share, and your rate climbs as your ads sell more. Your link pays 10% on anything bought through it.

settings.question: Do I have to post?
settings.answer: To earn, yes. Clubs come from posting every month, and ad money comes from videos we can run. No quota beyond that, and no script.

settings.question: Can I work with other brands?
settings.answer: Yes. We don't ask you to stop.

settings.question: Does applying sign me up for anything?
settings.answer: No. If you're accepted, you'll agree to the terms and privacy policy before anything else happens.

settings.heading: “It's better to be lucky.”
settings.lede: Post it, and we'll put money behind it.
